title: ActionAid Association Expresses Concern About Escalating Labour Situation at the Indian Oil Corporation Limited Refinery in Panipat
description: ActionAid Association expresses deep concern over the escalating labour situation at the Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) Panipat Refinery & Petrochemical Complex in Haryana. News reports of prolonged protests by contract workers, allegations of excessive working hours, wage-related grievances, unsafe conditions, and recent incidents of violence are deeply troubling..
